# Handpoint Developer Documentation

> Handpoint provides integrated payment acceptance for ISVs: a Cloud REST API for PAX SmartPOS terminals, native Android/iOS/Cordova/JavaScript/Windows SDKs, and back-office remote payment operations (remote sale, pre-auth capture, batch close). Supported acquirers: EPI (TSYS US/Canada), EmerchantPay, Paystrax, PAYSAFE, TNS.

---

## AI Agent Skills (machine-readable integration guides)

Load these skills before writing integration code. The index tells you which skills to load for your acquirer and integration path.

- [Skills Index](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/index.json): Structured JSON index of all available skills
- [Entry Point](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/handpoint.md): Start here — workflow instructions for loading the right skills
- [Cloud REST API Skill](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/paths/cloud-api.md): Complete Cloud API reference — authentication, all endpoints, polling, error handling, UNDEFINED recovery
- [EPI Acquirer Skill](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/acquirers/epi.md): EPI-specific capabilities, batch close, tip adjustment, partial reversal, MOTO
- [Back-Office Operations Skill](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/optional/back-office.md): Remote sale, card token charging, batch close, deferred tokenization
- [Integration Compliance Checklist](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/optional/integration-checklist.md): Receipt requirements, logging, recovery patterns, reconciliation

- [MOTO — Card Not Present](https://developer.handpoint.com/reference/moto-guide): On-terminal keyed entry and remote card token MOTO flows
- [Transaction Recovery — Cloud API](https://developer.handpoint.com/reference/transaction-recovery-cloud-api): UNDEFINED handling, /status endpoint, recovery flow

## Acquirers

- [EPI (TSYS US/Canada)](https://developer.handpoint.com/acquirers/epi): Batch close, tip adjustment, partial reversal, AVS, pre-auth
- [EmerchantPay](https://developer.handpoint.com/acquirers/omnipay-emp): EU acquirer, tip-in-sale, auto-settlement
- [Paystrax](https://developer.handpoint.com/acquirers/omnipay-paystrax): EU/Iceland acquirer, same protocol as EmerchantPay
- [PAYSAFE](https://developer.handpoint.com/acquirers/paysafe-tsys): Interac void-only rule, no partial reversal, Paysafe CNP portal
- [Acquirer Capabilities Matrix](https://developer.handpoint.com/reference/full-matrix): Full matrix of capabilities per acquirer and integration path

## Key Facts for AI Agents

- Staging: `https://cloud.handpoint.io` | Production: `https://cloud.handpoint.com`
- Auth header: `ApiKeyCloud` (case-insensitive; one key per merchant)
- POST /transactions → 202 Accepted → poll GET /transaction-result/{id} (204 = still processing, 200 = done)
- POST /reversal → synchronous, HTTP 200, no finStatus in response, httpStatus is integer 200
- POST /moto/sale → synchronous, HTTP 200, reversal key is in `guid` field (not transactionID)
- POST /batch/close → synchronous, httpStatus is string "200" (differs from /reversal integer)
- Amount fields: requestedAmount / totalAmount / tipAmount / dueAmount (no bare `amount` in result)
- transactionReference: UUID v4 you generate; persist before sending; required for recovery via GET /transactions/{ref}/status
